opportunities.name: Trip planning: flight + hotel + activity, saved to notes
opportunities.description: For a destination and dates, search Google Flights, Booking.com hotels, and a Viator activity, then save a summary note of prices.
steps: Open Google Flights, set origin Paris, destination, and dates, search
Open Booking.com, enter destination and dates, search, open top hotel and note price
Open Viator, search for the activity, open top result and note price
Open notes app and add a note 'Trip <dest> <dates>: flight..., hotel..., activity...'

instances.values: Rome, Dec 3-7 2026, Colosseum tour Rome (Lisbon flight search earlier as exploration)
Barcelona, Jan 20-24 2027, Sagrada Familia tour Barcelona
